title: Closed fold counts duplicates and swallows the cursor
description:
In a pane shorter than the plan, the live frame collapses closed rows into '✓ 64 closed' beside a header of '61/62 ticks': the fold counts the three duplicate rows (dvv, log, qrl) that progress excludes. And j/k walk the cursor through the collapsed rows, so after `jjj` no row carries '▸' while enter opens a tick (0rx) the person cannot see they selected. Count the fold as progress counts, and expand (or mark) the row under the cursor.
evidence: internal/cli/watch_view.go:1184-1205 (fitDashboard), :1260 (dashCollapseClosed), internal/cli/watch_keys.go:95-98 (watchNeighbourTick over watchPlanOrder); live 120x40 frame of epic-hn6
